decisions.reason: Heavy investment, a visible dedicated page and public government references such as the UK Home Office and over 30 APIS schemes make this product central to the firm's aviation direction, so management will persist with it.
Post-pandemic demand for travel health data keeps fading, but the dedicated page and its fit with the travel data offer let management attribute weak results to temporary conditions for another year.
Behaviour analysis anchors the firm's specialist detection identity and announced innovation path, so management keeps justifying it despite its low visibility.
Passenger profiling draws on long-standing aviation security expertise and sunk development effort, which management uses to justify continuing it.
